_comment: Where the Projects UI bundle (agentic_os/projects_ui) comes from. On the converged trunk it is NOT tracked in git: scripts/fetch_projects_ui.py (run by the wheel build hook, so by `pip install -e .` too) unpacks the pinned artifact packaging/ui-artifacts/projects-ui-root-312a811a.tgz (packaging/projects_ui.lock.json) into agentic_os/projects_ui, offline. Read by packaging/sbom/generate_source_offer.py and packaging/sbom/analyze.py and checked against the files by tests/test_ui_bundle_source_record.py. The source commit is a LOCAL, UNPUBLISHED commit: the public redevops-projects repository does not contain it, so this record is NOT a source offer (decisions D-LIC-12 and pins-04 stay OPEN). index.html, the JavaScript and the CSS are build output; hero.jpg is not (the neutral placeholder is kept by scripts/build_projects_ui.sh).
source_status: local unpublished commit (branch ui/partly-sample of a local clone, from ui/runtime-mode 2f24719e (itself from ui/evidence-tracing ee958a01); adds the "Partly sample" chip for a runtime server whose provider-backed pages are still sample): the Sample chip and every sample-versus-recorded decision come from GET /api/ui-config (what the running server reports) instead of the VITE_PROJECTS_SAMPLE_DATA build flag, which is removed; the Settings > Data source panel, the tail-anchor wording and the browser harness that runs the real product are added. Below that: the merge of the public release v0.2.0 (84f17fce) into the local accessibility series rel/ui-v3 (2fdef7f5), the application-directory tab and the mission drill-down views. not pushed, no pull request, no tag
previous_bundle: assets/index-owr9wUfq.js sha256 da54adcd5c9be2070456dcab32146d2c0eb87504066f342ca7cc9b606be73f0e (built from 2f24719e, the same views without the Partly sample chip); before it assets/index-XAbPLomz.js from ee958a01, assets/index-C4jFACLN.js from 2fdef7f5

build.environment: env -i with PATH, throwaway HOME and TMPDIR, LANG and an isolated npm cache; VITE_PROJECTS_API=/ is the only build variable passed
build.reproduced: built three times from a clean git archive of the source commit, each in its own throwaway HOME, TMPDIR and npm cache (env -i, node v24.22.2, npm 11.19.1): index.html, the JavaScript and the CSS are byte-identical (and identical to the development build)

artifact.url_note: no release has been published for it; a later publication only fills in the lock's url

lock_change_since_base: one added line in package.json and in package-lock.json (the package licence field "SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE.md" that arrived with v0.2.0); no dependency was added, removed or changed
environment_flags_note: the only build variable is VITE_PROJECTS_API=/; VITE_PROJECTS_SAMPLE_DATA no longer exists (whether data is sample is reported by the running server, GET /api/ui-config)
